# Which screens to photograph, and in which appearance.
#
# Edit this file and commit — the Preview screens workflow runs on the change and
# posts the shots into its job log (and as artifacts). GitHub's web editor works
# fine from a phone.
#
# screens:    studio, home, archive, course, summit, yearbook, prints, wall-art,
#             map-studio, gallery-studio, detail, components
#             wall-art accepts a style: wall-art:grid, wall-art:ridgeline, wall-art:rings,
#             wall-art:thread, wall-art:strata
#             timeline accepts a scope: timeline:years, timeline:months, timeline:all,
#             timeline:gallery
#             print-engine runs the print writer's self-check and reports pass/fail
# appearance: light, dark, or both
#
# Requested for b507: two things to look at.
#
#   tabs@timeline — the drawn glyph set. Five icons on one 28pt grid at a 1.7pt stroke,
#   replacing five SF Symbols that never quite became a family. What to check: that they
#   render at all (they are vector assets, not symbols), that they tint for selection, and
#   that they read as one set rather than five pictures.
#
#   timeline:gallery — Gallery as the fourth segment beside Years / Months / All. The tiles
#   are placeholders (the simulator has no photo library), so what is being checked is the
#   four-up scope control not truncating, the month headers, and the grid.
#
# screens: a product tile can be named directly, e.g. studio@lithograph

screens=tabs@timeline,timeline:gallery
appearance=both
